647-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-7889-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7889-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

339-677-728-1753.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3899-5058-6351.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6730-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
6495-6730-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 4.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5631-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5631-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4802-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

4399-4770-5998-6720.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5998-6720.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

215-647-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-647-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-647-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

5256-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
5256-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

3750-7015-7020.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Sun Warriors.
3750-7015-7020.description:
Declare Sun Warriors as an attacker, triggering its ability, adding an amount of {R} equal to the number of creatures you control.
Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Ozai.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-7015-7020.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can make infinite Allies using Sun Warriors. If you control five or less creatures, you can also attack with Ozai to get infinite mana.

2459-3967-4053-6989.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3944-5220-6634-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

628-5231-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-5231-6863--133.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Repeat.
628-5231-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

224-2248-5621.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

1992-2292-5994.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-2292-5994.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight token enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Knight.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

849-1020-2146-2866-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {1}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it and Anax trigger.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Satyr, adding {R}.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Fiend Hunter

372-1734-4284.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Clone until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Clone leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Clone from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Fiend Hunter.
Clone enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

511-2034-3062-3517.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with at least three spore counters on it.
511-2034-3062-3517.description:
Activate a creature you control by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling enters the battlefield, triggering Tainted Observer.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put two spore counters on any creature you control.
Repeat.

3769-4691-5076.notablePrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
3769-4691-5076.description:
Attack with Blim, dealing combat damage to an opponent.
Blim triggers, giving that player control of Vilis and causing each player to lose life and discard cards equal to the number of permanents they control but don't own.
Vilis triggers, causing that player to draw cards equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Kederekt Parasite triggers, dealing 1 damage to that player.
Repeat from step 4.
